title: BLES01658 Dragon Ball Z Budokai HD Collection
config: shader=Legacy single-threaded, wcb=false, async_tex=false, mt_rsx=false, spu_block=Safe, accurate_res=true
finding: fbo_commit synchronous readback eliminated (fbo_commit readbacks total=0): the 559 commit-time path is gone.
The game reads back one full 1280x720x4 (3.68 MB) colour surface per frame via CPU fault (dropped=0): every deferred region is read.
The readback cost did not disappear; it moved from the RSX thread (559 commit) to the faulting thread (560 fault_read), ~8 ms/frame in combat, scaling with GPU frame time.
Net FPS in sustained combat ~42, unchanged vs the 559 DBZ baseline (42.2). 560 is NEUTRAL for DBZ.
No freeze (no FREEZE_DUMP for 560) and no crash; teardown messages only at shutdown. 560 is safe.
interpretation: DBZ is GPU-readback bound: it demands the colour buffer in guest memory every frame. Deferring the write-back is correct and safe but cannot remove an intrinsic per-frame GPU readback the title requires. §6 of docs/rpcs3-cell560.md predicted exactly this.
